text: Artificial intelligence is changing the modern workplace in many ways. One major change is automation, as machines now handle repetitive tasks that people used to do. This allows workers to focus on more creative and complex projects. Many companies also use AI-powered productivity tools, such as smart calendars and writing assistants, to help employees manage their time better. In addition, human-AI collaboration is becoming more common, where people and machines work together to solve problems. However, these developments also mean that some jobs may change or even disappear, so workers need to learn new skills to stay competitive.
